meaning: A program that creates, stores and fills in your passwords for you. You only need to remember one strong password.
clues: It helps keep your online accounts safe.
It has to do with your passwords.
It's a program that runs on your phone or computer.
It can make a strong password for each account and fill it in when you log in.
Its name has two words, and the second one has seven letters.
assumes: A passphrase is a password made of a few words
A security key is a small device you plug in or tap
Biometric login uses your fingerprint or face

decoys.meaning: A password made of a few random words, like Horse Purple Hat Run Bay.
A small physical device you plug in or hold near your phone to prove it's you.
Proving who you are with your fingerprint or your face.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A good lock needs one key you guard well. Here you remember just one strong password.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Your phone or browser may already have one built in. Ask them to show you where.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: And keep that one password to yourself, same as the others.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Also turn on two-factor login for your email. Password reset links go there.

sources.name: Apple Support, strong passwords on iPhone

blank.sentence: My ___ makes a strong password for each account, so I only need to remember one.

why: It lets you use a strong password for each account without remembering them all.

situations.text: A friend offers to help and asks you to share the one strong password for your password manager. Should you tell them?
situations.why: Keep that one password to yourself, same as the others.
